headline: Senegal Supreme Court Maintains Suspension of Starlink Licence
summary: Senegal's Supreme Court kept Starlink's operating licence suspended following a legal challenge initiated by telecom operator Sonatel.
why: Starlink provides satellite-based internet services globally, challenging traditional terrestrial telecom operators. Regulatory disputes in key African markets affect the expansion of satellite broadband operators across the region.

impacts.name: Starlink
impacts.why: The court's decision keeps the service licence frozen, delaying market entry in Senegal.
